verdict.rationale: Looking up filing status is a fair question for a state business-filing office, but the pack has no evidence of a public status lookup for Secretary of State filings, applications, or cases. The only status feature is OH|TAX refund-status checking, which belongs to the separate tax agency and concerns tax refunds rather than SOS filings, so it does not transfer. The SOS sites themselves returned 403 at robots.txt, and nothing beyond that was fetched.

support.subject: As a founder, I can look up the status of my filing, application, or case from the service's public pages
